features.title: User lifecycle and email/password
features.appliesTo: Authentication / Identity Platform; client and Admin REST; configured project
limitations: Broad route and lifetime invariants only; atomic per-operation source mappings and target-version observations remain open. Real email/SMS delivery and anti-abuse are separate boundaries.

features.title: Tokens and sessions
features.appliesTo: Authentication; Secure Token and Admin verification paths; project/tenant binding
limitations: Revocation behavior must be checked separately for each verifier and service; no release-specific evidence is attached.

features.title: TOTP enrollment and sign-in
features.appliesTo: Identity Platform; explicit auth.totp configuration; supported verified first factor; tenant-specific settings
limitations: The existing Auth production corpus has no TOTP program. Linked invariants do not yet cover all eligibility, unenrollment and provider constraints.

features.title: SMS multi-factor authentication
features.appliesTo: Identity Platform; configured MFA and first-factor eligibility
limitations: Local verification codes do not attest real SMS delivery, retries, anti-abuse or production MFA configuration.

features.title: Tenant isolation and configuration
features.appliesTo: Identity Platform; project and tenant client/Admin REST routes
limitations: Per-tenant provider, MFA and policy combinations need additional source and oracle mappings.

features.title: Federated identity-provider fixtures
features.appliesTo: Local fixture assertion handling; OAuth/OIDC/SAML protocol and real provider verification are distinct
limitations: A fake JWT or JSON SAML assertion is not a real provider credential exchange.

features.title: Blocking authentication functions
features.appliesTo: Identity Platform; configured before-create and before-sign-in hooks
limitations: Hook ordering, rollback and configuration need source-section and live-oracle review.

features.title: Document reads, writes and queries
features.appliesTo: Firestore Standard / Native; per-database rules, indexes and profile; REST and gRPC considered separately
limitations: The broad parity requirement is not full method/field/enum coverage. Commit atomicity and BatchWrite partial outcomes must not be conflated.

features.title: Count, sum and average
features.appliesTo: Firestore Standard / Native; query/index configuration; REST and gRPC
limitations: Historical queries/aggregations corpus observations exist but are not accepted for this source tree. Streaming equivalence is not a substitute for production semantics.

features.title: Transactions and contention
features.appliesTo: Standard / Native; configured concurrency mode must be read back; transaction tokens and retry paths
limitations: Edition does not determine the observed database concurrency mode. Exact timeout, retry and ordering assertions remain to be mapped.

features.title: Listen and stream lifecycle
features.appliesTo: Standard / Native; gRPC Listen and SDK WebChannel; reconnect/resume behavior
limitations: Resource bounds do not establish event completeness, order or all resume histories. REST availability must not be inferred from stream support.

features.title: Rules and index configuration
features.appliesTo: Standard / Native; per-database rules/index catalog; request authentication and budgets
limitations: Standard index requirements cannot be transferred unconditionally to Enterprise. Refusal assertions must inspect unchanged state.

features.title: Pipeline decoding and validation
features.appliesTo: Enterprise / Native; validation-only pipeline configuration and owner authorization as declared by the capability
limitations: Valid pipelines return an unimplemented execution response. Parser acceptance is not local query execution.

features.title: Text index definition validation
features.appliesTo: Enterprise / Native; local text-index definition/control configuration
limitations: Backfill, posting data, search scoring and local search execution are not established by definition validation.

features.title: MongoDB-compatible API and drivers
features.appliesTo: Firestore with MongoDB compatibility; published supported API/type/driver set still to inventory
limitations: Unmapped: no Standard/Native or generic MongoDB compatibility result transfers to this goal.

features.title: Database, index and retention administration
features.appliesTo: Database/index administration; TTL, backup/restore, PITR, import/export and operation lifecycle
limitations: Admin discovery fields and long-running operation semantics remain unclassified; configuration acceptance does not imply managed-service execution.

features.title: Client and Admin SDK behavior
features.appliesTo: Web/Node client and Admin SDKs; offline/cache/listeners and auth handoff; mobile platforms separately inventoried
limitations: The linked rules-unit-testing requirement covers one integration path only. Offline, pending writes, mobile SDKs and target-version runs remain unmapped.

features.title: Managed cloud operations and external providers
features.appliesTo: Real IAM, billing, regions, CMEK, email/SMS, IdPs, network and anti-abuse services
limitations: Local response/configuration simulation does not reproduce cloud operations. External dependencies remain visible and must be verified separately.
